desc: Implement count(x): return 0 if x <= 0; extract digits of x; for each target sum s in 1..81, run tight digit DP over positions with state (pos, sum_so_far, prod mod s, has_zero, started), pruning when sum > s, counting numbers with digit-sum == s and (has_zero or prod % s == 0).
Test against examples (10,20)->2, (1,15)->10; brute-force cross-check small ranges and edge cases (single digits, numbers with zeros like 100, l=r=1, r=999999999).
